chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā ibn ʿUbayd narrated from Zakariyyā al-Muʾmin, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Nuʿaym, from Abū Ḥamzah, from one of the Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, says:
O son of Adam, I have bestowed favor upon you with three things:

I concealed concerning you that which, had your family known of it, they would not have buried you. And I gave you abundance, then I sought a loan from you, but you did not send forward any good. And I granted you respite at your death regarding your one-third, but you did not send forward any good.

key_terms.اِبْنَ آدَمَ: the human being addressed directly by Allah
key_terms.تَطَوَّلْتُ عَلَيْكَ بِثَلَاثٍ: I bestowed three favors upon you
key_terms.سَتَرْتُ عَلَيْكَ: I concealed your faults and shortcomings
key_terms.فَاسْتَقْرَضْتُ مِنْكَ: I asked of you a loan, meaning charitable spending in Allah’s cause
key_terms.فِي ثُلُثِكَ: in your one-third, referring to the portion available for bequest
key_terms.نَظِرَةً: a period of respite or granted opportunity

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about charity, hidden faults, and making a bequest before death?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a divine address reminding the human being of three favors from Allah: concealment of faults, abundance in provision, and the opportunity to dispose of one-third of one's wealth at death. It is a warning against neglecting charity and failing to make a beneficial bequest before death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5410 - Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd narrated from Zakariyya Al-Mu'min from Ali ibn Abi Nuaym from Abu Hamzah from one of the Imams (peace be upon them), who said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), the Blessed and Exalted, says:
'O' son of Adam, I have favored you with three things:
I concealed from others matters about you that, had your family known, they would not have buried you.
I expanded your sustenance, yet when I asked you to lend (in charity), you did not offer any good.
And I granted you a respite at your death in one-third of your wealth, yet you did not present any good.'"
